smart_group: connected ISO UTC weeks; cycles crossing a week join both weeks
smart_partitions: first seeded group split with both classes and at least one positive group in each role; no model scores used
smart_group_support_limit: only four positive connected week blocks; a two-positive-group minimum per role was infeasible before any model experiment
kaist_limit: two sampled loads; no independent third test load or equipment
other_partitions: sorted dependency groups, every third group validation; remainder train; no binary test reference
candidate_representation: single-channel temporal vibration shape; positive-scale/offset invariant, not bandwidth or machine invariant
smart_features: provider cycle aggregates; duration differs from KAIST windows

model_comparison.purpose: fixed feasibility experiment, not the final artifact or external validation
model_comparison.weights: each source equal total weight, then inverse recording/day-group size within source

public_test_access: SMART test stays sealed for T17; feasibility uses only train and validation. KAIST has no reserved test load in this subset.

unsupervised.scope: train only; descriptive, never overwrites a reference label
unsupervised.scaling: RobustScaler fitted separately within each source on train only
unsupervised.stability: leave one dependency group out; adjusted Rand score on shared observations

transfer_policy: No pseudo-label accepted without an independent target reference; unresolved stays indeterminate.

prototype_public_minima.rationale: provisional PI feasibility bar, above balanced chance and majority-normal; not a reliability or safety claim

release_gate: at least two public measured sources contribute defensible labels
shared feature semantics and target relation supported, not merely numerical scale
group validation reports support and source bias; untested hypotheses remain conditional
all final inputs computable with documented acquisition support
independent external protocol and true condition required before local accuracy claim
